- src/app/blog/page.tsx

## Step 3: Fix mismatches

For each page where the CtaBanner title/subtitle/button text doesn't match Webflow, update the page.tsx with the correct props:
```tsx
<CtaBanner
  title="..." // exact text from Webflow
  subtitle="..." // exact text from Webflow
  primaryCta={{ label: "...", href: "..." }}
  secondaryCta={{ label: "...", href: "..." }}
/>
```

Note: Our `CtaBanner` component signature is:
```tsx
CtaBanner({
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  primaryCta?: { label: string; href: string };
  secondaryCta?: { label: string; href: string };
})
```

Read all files before making any edits. Only change the CtaBanner props, do not change any other content.
